notes: UNVERIFIED CANDIDATES — NOT PLAYABLE. 40 Easy-tier candidates: 17 landmark, 23 urban, 0 remote, which clears all three Easy balance rules by construction. Targets the two remaining continent-depth shortages (Oceania 8, Africa 5) and spreads the rest over 33 countries, max 3 per country. Coordinates are placed on pedestrian squares, promenades and named streets in city centres rather than on open road, since Easy locations are recognisable places rather than roadside views. Every candidate was checked to be outside the 25 km cluster threshold of all 100 catalog entries AND of all 116 earlier candidates including failures — which is why Guam, Saipan, American Samoa, Perth and Havana are absent: every usable point in them falls inside 25 km of an earlier failure or an existing entry.
